name: AMD Radeon RX Vega 64
memory_bandwidth_basis: AMD product-page spec table (Wayback capture): Max. Memory Bandwidth 484 GB/s with Memory Interface 2048-bit and Memory Speed (Effective) 1.89 Gbps. 1.89 Gbps x 2048-bit / 8 = 483.8 GB/s, consistent.

flops.basis_detail: AMD product-page row Peak Half Precision Compute Performance 25.3 TFLOPs. No sparsity footnote is printed, so dense:true.
AMD product-page row Peak Single Precision Compute Performance 12.66 TFLOPs. No sparsity footnote, so dense:true.
AMD product-page row Peak Double Precision Compute Performance 0.79 TFLOPs. 0.79 / 12.66 is the 1:16 consumer rate, not the 1:2 rate of Radeon Pro VII.

notes: Reference Vega 10 card: 64 compute units, 4096 stream processors, 256 texture units, 12.5 billion transistors, base 1247 MHz, boost 1546 MHz, typical board power 295 W, launched Q3 2017. All figures come from the Wayback capture of the AMD product page. 8 GB of HBM2 holds a 7B Q4 and not a 13B Q4. Liquid-cooled and air variants shipped; the 295 W figure is the desktop board power printed on this page. No GPU-to-GPU fabric.
